events.summary: Worcester 20s & 30s 2nd Annual Hostel Takeover Weekend in the White Mountains

description.plain:
Friday, June 26, 2026 | 8:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX00000152yH2AQ/
Join the Worcester Chapter 20s & 30s for a weekend of outdoor fun in the White Mountains June 26-29 for the second annual Hostel Takeover! This year’s theme is…aliens! Expect the theme to crop up throughout the trip; participation in it is optional!The trip runs from the evening of Friday, June 26 through Monday, June 29. A variety of hiking and socializing opportunities will be offered each day as we explore several regions of the White Mountains. At least two hiking options, one moderate and one vigorous, will be provided each day (for rating definitions, go here). Specific offerings will be determined by leaders that weekend depending on participant ability and conditions. Hikes will be in the immediate area and possibly others farther afield. After the days’ hikes, we will all return to the Conway Hostel (CoHo), our basecamp for the weekend. The trip includes three nights’ lodging at CoHo, where you will find all the comforts you are looking for after a long hike– shared bunk rooms, private bathrooms, a shared kitchen with full access, and shared space for socializing. A group dinner will be included and served on Saturday and Sunday evening, and CoHo offers free coffee, tea, and granola bars for breakfasts. Friday night dinner will be an optional potluck. Breakfast (other than what the hostel offers) and lunches not included. Evening activities will be offered, possibilities including a movie screening, star gazing, fire pit, and games. The hostel is also a ~5 minute walk away from the Saco River where swimming is allowed.Cost is $170 for AMC members ($185 for non-members) per person for 3 nights at CoHo and 2 dinners. If the cost of this trip is an obstacle for you being able to attend, please reach out to Jake at jjscoggin@gmail.com, as we have limited subsidy options available. Refunds are not guaranteed and are dependent on someone taking your spot if this event reaches full capacity. Once you register for the trip here, one of the leaders will send a screening form to gather further information to ensure the trip will be safe and fun for all participants. Payment will be collected once your spot on the trip has been confirmed.Gear is available for loan through the Worcester Chapter Gear Shed for those who may need it. No dogs, please.As an affinity group within AMC that is dedicated to encouraging people in their 20s and 30s to enjoy the outdoors, this is a trip for those in their 20s and 30s.

events.summary: 20's & 30's Full Moon Hike at Mt. Wachusett

description.plain:
Wednesday, July 1, 2026 | 7:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001BMZJ2A4/
Join us for an evening hike up Mt. Wachusett during an (almost) full moon, aka, the Strawberry Moon! We will hike 3-5 miles (depending on if we take a shorter route) with a total elevation gain of about 750 ft. Weather permitting, we plan to spend some time at the summit to enjoy the moon and stars and perhaps some snacks. The trails will include sections of moderate terrain and we will be moving at a moderate pace.Proper equipment will be required for this hike, including: hiking and weather appropriate clothing, water, a day pack, and a headlamp. No dogs please.

events.summary: 20s & 30s July Social at Sterling Street Brewery in Clinton

description.plain:
Friday, July 10, 2026 | 6:30 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001CAFx2AO/
Get outside with the Worcester Chapter! Join us at Sterling Street Brewery in Clinton on Friday July 10th starting at 6:30pm. Learn about fun upcoming trips and activities this summer, meet like-minded outdoors enthusiasts, and talk with leaders from the Worcester Chapter! Everyone is welcome to join. There are plenty of drink options, including non-alcoholic, as well as food available. We may be outside on the patio if the weather is nice. The event starts at 6:30 but feel free to come when you can!For more info about Sterling Street Brewery, visit: https://www.sterlingstreetbrewery.com/

Saturday, July 11, 2026 | 9:00 AM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001BqfR2AS/
The dirt calls to us! And so we must heed it's call! Time for TRAIL WORK!Looking to get out and contribute your time to some wonderful trails? Then look no further! We're putting together a work party along Section 3 of the New England Trail (near Springfield). We'll be building an approach trail for a new campsite that will be installed there. If you have any prior experience with trail work experience that's excellent. If not, no worries! You'll be trained and supervised on the ground by AMC Trails Department staff, and you'll walk away with more wonderful, trail maintenance knowledge than you arrived with.All PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) and tools will be provided on site. If you have your own PPE you are welcome to use it if it is rated appropriately. Participants are responsible for bringing their own work clothes (pants and boots required, long sleeves recommended). Participants must also provide their own water and trail lunch.NOTE: Trail Work is physically demanding. Participants must be capable of (but not limited to) a 1 mile hike with fully loaded pack, work on your feet for multiple hours, the ability to safely use hand tools, and the ability to follow instructions. Rest is of course available, but please be mindful that this is a physically demanding activity. Different tasks and loads are available for different people, but expect to be active all day and to get dirty!At the end of the day after we've left the trail better than we found it we'll celebrate with some dinner paid for by the Worcester Chapter!Trail Work is an excellent opportunity to get out, meet some cool people, and see your hard work pay off with the betterment and stewardship of our outdoors. We hope to have you join us! Any questions at all please let us know!This event is intended as an affinity work trip for people in their 20s & 30s. If you are not a member of that group, please do not sign up for this activity.

events.summary: 4th Annual 20s & 30s Trail Work Weekend in AMC’s Maine Woods

location.title:
75 Little Lyford Pond Rd
Greenville, ME

description.plain:
Friday, August 7, 2026 | 5:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001BgY12AK/
Join the Worcester and Boston Chapter 20s & 30s groups for a weekend of trail work in the beautiful and remote Maine Woods! This three night, three day trip includes two full days of trail work and three nights' stay at AMC's Little Lyford Lodge, plus a hike/exploration day on Monday. Participants are encouraged to arrive by late afternoon/early evening Friday to provide ample time to get to the lodge for dinner before the gate closes.This trip is designed for people in their 20s & 30s who are interested in learning about trail work and bringing back newly gained skills to local chapter opportunities. No trail work experience is required, only a desire to learn trail work techniques and contribute to the restoration of mountain trails. Activities may include revitalizing trails, repairing benches and bridges, and building check steps and will be somewhat tailored to the interests and abilities of the group. The trail work will involve hiking a few miles each day with moderate elevation gain. We will be working under the leadership and guidance of AMC’s Professional Trail Crew with tools and safety gear provided. Expect to be out for about 6-7 hours Saturday and 6-7 hours Sunday.At the end of each day, we’ll enjoy social time and dinner back at the lodge. Enjoy the dark sky (New England’s only certified International Dark Sky Park!), the Perseid meteor shower, paddling on the pond, swimming in the Pleasant River, and campfires in the evening. Canoes and kayaks are free with our stay. Accommodations are cabins and a bunkhouse at Little Lyford, one of AMC's lodges in the heart of the 100-mile Wilderness in the Maine Woods. Breakfast, trail lunch, and dinner (Friday dinner through Monday breakfast) are included with the cost of the stay. The cost for the 3 night trip is $345. Once you register for the activity here, the leaders will send a separate screening form. Once participants have registered and have been confirmed, a leader will reach out with the required information for payment.Cancellation policy: Participants must notify trip leaders as soon as possible if they can no longer participate. A refund will be issued ONLY IF leaders can fill your spot.
